exposure: Timing of cesarean section (planned vs. emergent)
cohort: 84 patients who underwent cesarean section for placenta previa.
finding: Emergency cesarean delivery for placenta previa was not associated with increased maternal morbidity compared to planned cesarean delivery, although emergent cases had lower birth weight and higher NICU admission due to earlier gestational age at delivery.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery: 34+/-2.4 weeks for emergent group, 36+/-2.3 weeks for planned group
birth_weight: Lower birth weight in the emergent cesarean delivery group
